settings.exec.label: Command
settings.exec.description: Prints the state as one JSON line: { glyph, text, tooltip, class }. No glyph hides the widget.
settings.watch.label: Watch command
settings.watch.description: Long-running command; each line it prints re-runs the command.
settings.interval.label: Interval (seconds)
settings.interval.description: Also re-run the command this often. 0 turns it off.
settings.colors.label: Colours
settings.colors.description: Class to colour: green, yellow or red from the theme, a colour role, or a hex value.
settings.blink.label: Blinking classes
